engines.notes: CPU TTS and consent-gated voice cloning. The Kyberion bridge emits complete WAV artifacts. A configured registry override may opt into model_id english_18m_2026-10, english_7m_2026-10 or english_2m_2026-10 with a compatible upstream runtime. These English Small models are not the default. Only the 1.9M configuration has a short local WAV-generation measurement; streaming latency and listening quality remain unverified. Current upstream language packs do not include Japanese.
engines.language_notes: Bridge rejects Japanese; upstream packs for fr/de/pt/it/es exist but the bridge does not select a language pack, so only en is declared.
